title: Grateful Dead Live at Washington University on 1969-04-17
lineage: Transfer Info: Cassette Master > DAT (44.1k) > FLAC  Mastering Info: FLAC > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Nice soundboard capture of a rare show with strong Dark Stars and cryptic transitions, though the recording has minor sound‑engineer hiccups.
ai_review.review: The SBD source delivers a clear and enjoyable listen, especially highlighting a powerful Dark Stars and an unusual Cryptical > Caution segue that fans note as a unique moment. While most listeners praise the overall flow from start to finish, there are complaints about late‑start delays, police interference, and some questionable song choices (the diverted St Stephen’s and a weak Eleven fake‑out).

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show highly (4–5 stars) and note good soundboard quality; however, a few detailed criticisms lower the overall confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call it a "nice SBD" with generally clear audio, though one notes Bear's extended sound‑check hassles that may affect the mix slightly.

poor_songs: St Stephen's (It's a Sin diverted version)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert features an unconventional Cryptical > Caution transition and a delayed start caused by venue issues, giving the show a quirky but memorable pacing.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh insisted on an unprecedented Cryptical > Caution segue.
